description.p: A small, native Markdown viewer and editor. Open a file, see it rendered, fix a typo when needed, and nothing more: no projects, plugins or workspaces, just a file and its preview.

ul.li: Three view modes: code only, preview only, or both side by side
Live preview with tables, task lists, strikethrough, footnotes and autolinks
Scroll sync between editor and preview
Code editor with Markdown syntax highlighting, line numbers, optional word wrap and a minimap
Editor themes (Breeze, Atom One, Catppuccin, GitHub, Solarized) with light and dark variants
Bundled code and preview fonts, with ligatures
Detects and converts file encodings and line endings
Reloads the open file when it changes on disk, including remote files over SFTP
